nodes.description: owner address stored in BotProtected, set to msg.sender in KonomiToken constructor and used as the only privileged account
botProtection address supplied at construction and used as the target of an unchecked low-level call in the checkBots modifier
uniPair address computed via pairFor(wETH, address(this)) and passed to the external bot-protection contract
public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf holding token balances of KonomiToken
public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] holding spending approvals
totalSupply constant-ish storage variable initialised to 100000000000000000000000000 and used in list() arithmetic
IUniswapV2Router02 uniRouter address used for addLiquidityETH external call
wETH address used together with the token address to derive the Uniswap pair
checkBots modifier that performs an unchecked low-level call to botProtection and requires the returned success flag before executing the function body
public payable transferFrom guarded by checkBots; mutates allowance and balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic
public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval
owner-only function that performs a.delegatecall(b) with fully attacker-controllable calldata
owner-only listing function that rewrites balances, calls uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with block.timestamp deadline and loops over recipient arrays
internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address from two tokens via keccak256 CREATE2 derivation
KonomiToken constructor that sets owner, derives uniPair and grants unlimited allowances to the router and pair
msg.sender controls transfer/approve/transferFrom/delegate/list entry points and is compared against owner
block.timestamp used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in list()
botProtection.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141, ...)) low-level external call executed before the guarded state changes; failure of returndata decoding is not handled
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary external code in the storage context of KonomiToken with user-supplied calldata
unchecked arithmetic allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath
unchecked arithmetic balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply * 6 / 100 and direct balance assignment in the list loop
deadline computed as block.timestamp + 600, a miner-manipulable timestamp dependency
external call uniRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) to a hardcoded router with no slippage/return validation
_from address parameter of transferFrom controlling whose balance and allowance are debited
_to address parameter of transferFrom receiving the credited balance
_value amount parameter of transferFrom used in allowance and balance arithmetic
_numList amount parameter of list() assigned to contract balance and forwarded as liquidity amount
_tos address array parameter of list() iterated to assign arbitrary balances
_amounts uint array parameter of list() supplying balances written for each recipient
a address parameter of delegate() which is the delegatecall target
b bytes parameter of delegate() used as raw delegatecall calldata
notABot bool returned by the low-level botProtection call and required to be true in checkBots
isNotBot bytes returndata buffer from the botProtection low-level call (decoded but unused)
pair address computed in pairFor from the sorted token pair hash
loop index i used in list() over _tos/_amounts

_to is a transferFrom parameter used solely for the credited balance write
_value is a transferFrom parameter consumed by the allowance/balance arithmetic
_numList is a list() parameter assigned to balances and forwarded to addLiquidityETH
_tos is a list() parameter iterated for balance writes and Transfer events
_amounts is a list() parameter supplying the balances written in the loop

parameter b is the calldata payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation

i is the loop counter local used only inside list()
